text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest` because this session has no shell tool. I checked each fix by reading the code against the tests, so please run the suite to confirm it passes.

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5, matching the lending policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the days late. It now multiplies them.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing the third book. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copies for Emma are my guess from `tests/test_search.py`, which uses the same values. The factory test only checks the title.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one in the slice. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list if `n` is 0 or less.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int, which also fixes `age()`.
